arithmetic: Identical complete dense matrix arithmetic and auxiliary unit-cost floating operation counts at the reference point.
controls: Same initial weights and real 128-move prefixes; complete encoder/policy/pending action; allocated 512-move cache, bounded 129-move attention extent; cache outputs observed and donated. ABBA implementation order with ten warm repetitions per case.
intervention: Carry the KV arrays through the layer loop and update only new slots. Retain original implementation as an explicit control. Reject malformed/overflowing pointers without writing cache bytes.
measurement: Report all host timings, numerical error, HLO hashes and argument/output/temp/alias memory. No speedup claim based solely on CPU tests or buffer-shape reasoning.
sequence: Run after the current registered transformer learning attempt closes; do not overlap pod jobs. This does not select an encoder or alter any learning run.
